title: Ramaphosa Urges Calm Ahead of Scheduled Anti-Migrant Protests
detail: President Cyril Ramaphosa called for calm as South Africa braced for scheduled anti-migrant protests, raising concerns about xenophobic violence and broader social stability. The protests reflect ongoing tensions over immigration in the country.

media.caption: President Ramaphosa urges calm ahead of anti-migrant protests amid xenophobia concerns
